text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—— We've returned in a bakushin…!! 
Hoh! Look at what happened to the cherry
blossoms 
while we were running through the
country…!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It shows how many places we visited on the
way! 
Hehe, it's been a fun journey♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It has!
And I'm certain many people all
throughout 
the country have had a lot of fun as
well…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! Let us have a little peek at just how much people have enjoyed themselves!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If we simply look at the comments left on
the videos 
I posted about our adventures on Umatter…!

!? Them bakushin lassies were over in me
hometown!!? 
An' thems lookin' like havin' a belly full
a laughs as well ^^) 
Oh, the joys!

I was pretty down about flower viewings
being 
cancelled,
but having Chiyo and friends come 
over cheered me right up!!

Everybody'd been waitin' for the Sakura trio
to come 
on over from the far south… It almost be
like the actual 
cherry blossom front, hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There are so many comments…! And even more neighces and rehoofs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmh! I'd say it's been a great success!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A grand victory, huh… Then it's time for that, wouldn't you say?
